critical_code_review_comments: ROOT-CAUSE BUG (P0): improved_ai_ml_system.py::_save_model L655-663 and maximized_ai_ml_system.py::_save_model L876+ DO NOT serialize the tuner_feature_names + tuner_selected_mask attributes that ml_accuracy_tuner.train_from_otc sets on the instance (ml_accuracy_tuner.py L669-670). On every backend restart those attrs vanish, predict_with_tuner_pipeline gets vec.shape=(1,84) into a model trained on 70 SelectKBest-selected features → 'X has 84 features, RandomForestClassifier is expecting 70' (verified locally). E1's curl validation worked only because it was on the SAME process that had just trained — a hot-reload or restart breaks the wire-up.

predict_with_tuner_pipeline (ml_accuracy_tuner.py L843-847) tries to pad/truncate vec to scaler.n_features_in_ but SelectKBest happens AFTER scaling — the truncation logic does not help when the model was fit on a SelectKBest-reduced subset. The mask is the only way to map 84→70, and it must be persisted.

Component exception handlers in routes/signals.py L4387 and L4410 use logger.debug — DEBUG level is suppressed in supervisor's default config so the silent ML failure was invisible. Promote to logger.warning at minimum.
